responsibility: This file lowers D frontend types into GCC tree types and owns much of the D type-layout logic. It provides signed/unsigned type helpers, `va_list` and empty-aggregate predicates, type equality tests, array and builtin struct constructors, qualifier insertion, aggregate field insertion and completion, and a visitor that builds GCC representations for all major D types—including enums, structs, classes, arrays, delegates, and vectors—while applying D-specific attributes, visibility, addressability, inheritance metadata, and ABI layout rules.
